review_rule: Every owner-bound component must appear together in this one image; partial_is_fail.

gates.evidence: Fine flyaways visibly emerge from the subject hairline and temple into the larger hair mass.
Loose local strands and the main hair mass flow toward camera-left together.
Camera-left flyaways agree with the wind response of the larger hair and the rain scene.
Hair wisps lie across or beside the cheek with separable contours and no visible skin penetration.
The clear umbrella canopy and outer ribs cross the top frame boundary.
The adult face, umbrella grip, printed route card, and reading gaze remain clear despite the upper crop.
The view is near standing phone height and background posts remain close to upright with a plausible level tilt.
The cropped canopy ribs continue in smooth arcs toward the unseen canopy beyond the top edge.
Wet rail and path form the near layer, the woman and card the middle layer, and bridge skyline the far layer.
Far buildings and bridge details show lower contrast than the sharply textured near railing.
The far haze and contrast falloff fit the gray overcast light and freshly wet bridge.
Foreground droplets, metal rail edges, hair, and route card remain readable.
Rain droplets on the canopy and railing plus a glossy wet walkway establish a wet receiving surface.
Pale sky and bridge lamps are visible above the wet walkway and its reflective patch.
The bright lower-right reflective patch contains dark vertical shapes, but one exact in-frame source cannot be traced to a unique matched position at native scale.
The promised shoe interruption is outside the lower crop; no clear foreground occluder visibly breaks one identified reflected owner.
The walkway remains visibly wet across the frame; a concrete dry strip adjacent to the puddle is not distinguishable.

reference_appearance.evidence: The rendered adult has long dark wavy hair and broadly similar visible facial contour and brow/eye cues to the supplied portrait. This is appearance guidance only, not an identity claim.
